content: Aseqsi x man ttesriḥ i zi ittegg Yasuɛ řeɛjayeb nnes
Deg ijj zeg wussan nni, am tuɣa netta isseřmad řgens di Zzawect Tameqqrant, ittbarreḥ s Řexbar Aṣebḥan, xenni ɣewwɣen xas imeqqranen n ikehhanen d imseřmaden n idlisen ak-d imɣaren n řgens.
Ssiwřen akides, nnan: “Ini aneɣ, s man ttesriḥ i tᵉttegged aya, niɣ man wen i d ac iwcin ttesriḥ-a?”
Yarra-dd Yasuɛ, inna asen: “Uřa d Necc ad kenniw sseqsiɣ ijj n useqsi. Inim ayi:
Ma aseɣḍeṣ n Yuḥanna zeg ujenna niɣ zeg iwdan?”
Mcawaren jar asen, nnan: “Mařa nenna: ‘Zeg ujenna!’, ad yini: ‘Mayemmi xenni war zzayes tuminem?’
Mařa nenna: ‘Zeg iwdan!’, ad aneɣ yarjem marra řgens, minzi nitni ttwassqenɛen belli Yuḥanna d anabi.”
Nnan as: “Neccin war nessin zi manis!”
Xenni inna asen Yasuɛ: “Xenni uřa d Necc war d awem qqareɣ s man ttesriḥ i tteggeɣ aya!”
Amedya n umarjuɛ n uḍiř d ixemmasen iɛeffanen
Ibda ittɛawad i řgens amedya-ya: “Ijj n bnadem igga ijj n umarjeɛ n uḍiř, iẓẓu dayes tizayarin, icra amarjeɛ i ixemmasen, uca isafar ijj n řmijař n řweqt d azirar.
Ařami dd-yiweḍ řḥař, issekk ijj n umsexxar ɣar ixemmasen ḥima ad as wcen zeg uḍiř n umarjeɛ. Wtin t ixemmasen nni uca ssekken t-i-dd ixwa.
Xenni issekk ɛawed ijj n umsexxar nneɣni, wtin t ɛawed, deǧen t, xenni sekken t-i-dd ixwa.
Issekk ɛawed amsexxar wiss třata, maca nitni ssyezmen t ɛawed uca nḍaren t ɣar barra.
Inna bab n umarjeɛ n uḍiř: ‘Min ɣa ggeɣ? Ad ssekkeɣ mmi iɛizzen. Xmi t ɣa ẓaren, ad t weqqaren nican.’
Umi t ẓrin ixemmasen, mcawaren jar asen, nnan: ‘Aqa d wa d awrit. Zid ad t nneɣ, ḥima ad ɣarneɣ dd-idweř řwart.’
Mmenḍaren t barra i umarjeɛ n uḍiř uca nɣin t. Min zzaysen i ɣa yegg xenni bab n umarjeɛ n uḍiř?
Ad dd-yas, ad ineɣ ixemmasen nni, uca ad iwc amarjeɛ n uḍiř i inneɣni.” Umi sřin aya, nnan as: “Ɛemmarṣ!”
Maca Netta ixzar ɣarsen, inna: “Min ixs ad yini xenni wawař-a i yuran:
‘Aẓru i tuɣa iɛiffen ibennayen, aqa idweř d aẓru n Uzeǧif n teɣmart!
Marra wi ɣa iwḍan x weẓru-ya, ad ifartek, u wenni xef i ɣa iwḍa, ad t iřbez’?”
Arezzun imseřmaden n idlisen d imeqqranen n ikehhanen ad xas ssarsen ifassen di tsaɛɛet nni, maca nitni ggʷeden zeg iwdan, minzi ssnen belli Netta inna amedya-ya xasen.
Aseqsi x uxeǧeṣ n ḍḍariba i qayṣar
Ḥḍan t uca ssekken ibergagen inni iggin ixef nsen amecnaw imseggaden, ḥima ad as ggen ijj n řfex di ssibbet n ijj n wawař, maḥend ad t sellmen i řqaḍi d jjehd n lɛamil.
Sseqsan t, nnan: “A Amseɣɣar, nessen belli Cek tessawařed u tesseřmaded nican, war tᵉttegged ca s wudmawen u tesseřmaded abrid n AREBBI s tidett.
Ma iḥeǧeř aneɣ ad newc řeɛcur i kuř ijjen uzeǧif i qayṣar niɣ lla?”
Yuca s teḥraymect nsen uca inna asen: “Mayemmi d ayi tᵉttjarrabem?
Secnem ayi-dd dinar. Wi yiřan taṣwirt-a d tira-ya?” Nnan as: “N qayṣar!”
Xas uca inna asen Yasuɛ: “Wcem xenni i qayṣar min iǧan i qayṣar u i AREBBI min iǧan i AREBBI!”
War zemmaren ad t ṭṭfen s wawař nnes qibač i iwdan, maca qqimen ttbehten s temwarrit nnes uca sseɣden.
Aseqsi n Iṣaduqiyyen x tnukra
Usin-dd ca zeg Iṣaduqiyyen inni iqqaren, war din bu tnukra zi řmewt. Sseqsan t,
nnan as: “A Amseɣɣar, yura aneɣ Musa, mařa immut i weryaz umas i ɣar iǧa tamɣart uca immut břa iḥenjiren, xenni ad yawi umas tamɣart nni, maḥend ad dd-yejj aḥenjir i umas.
Tuɣa din sebɛa n wawmaten. Amezwar yiwi ict n temɣart, maca immut břa iḥenjiren.
Yiwi wenni d wiss tnayen tamɣart nni uca uřa d netta immut břa iḥenjiren.
Xenni wenni d wiss třata yiwi tamɣart nni uca ammu inneɣni ař wiss sebɛa. Mmuten nitni marra idsen, war dd-jjin ca iḥenjiren.
Ɣar uneggar temmut temɣart ɛawed.
Di tnukra i man wen zzaysen i ɣa tiři d tamɣart? Minzi marra sebɛa nni iwyen tt d tamɣart!”
Inna asen Yasuɛ: “Ayt n ddunect-a iwyen timɣarin, u timɣarin ttwassmeǧacent i yeryazen.
Maca inni ittwaḥesben sdaheǧen ad awḍen ɣar ddunect nni u ɣar tnukra zi taddart n imettinen, war ttiwyen timɣarin, u timɣarin war ttiřint i yeryazen.
Maɣar war zemmaren ɛad ad mmten, minzi nitni am lmalakat u nitni d tarwa n AREBBI, minzi nitni dewřen d tarwa n tnukra.
Maca zi jjihet n imettinen ad ttwassnekkaren, tuɣa issbeyyan Musa ɛawed umi iḥaja x cbarq ak-d isennanen, aqa SIDI inna: ‘NECC d AREBBI n Ibrahim d AREBBI n Isḥaq d AREBBI n Yaɛqub.’
Netta war iǧi ca d AREBBI n imettinen, maca n yinni iddaren, minzi ɣares Netta nitni marra ddaren.”
Arrin-dd ca zeg imseřmaden n idlisen, nnan: “A Amseɣɣar, tessiwřed mliḥ aṭṭas!”
Uca war zɛimen ɛad ad t sseqsan x ca.
Man wen iǧan d mmis n Dawud?
Inna asen: “Mammec zemmaren imseřmaden n idlisen ad inin belli Lmasiḥ d Mmis n Dawud?
Dawud simant nnes iqqar deg wedlis n Izehhiden:
‘SIDI inna i Sidi inu: Qqim x ufusi inu,
ař d ɣa ssarseɣ řɛedyan nnec sadu iḍaren nnec.’
Mařa Dawud isemma t ‘Sidi’, mammec ɣa yiři Netta d mmis?”
Yasuɛ d Imseřmaden n idlisen
Am tuɣa marra iwdan zemmaren ad sřen, inna i imeḥḍaren nnes:

“Ḥḍam ixef nwem zeg imseřmaden n idlisen inni ittexsen ad uyuren s ijeǧaben iziraren, inni umi itteɛjib asen ad xasen seǧmen iwdan di řeswaq u ad qqimen x řekrasi iṣebḥen di temzidawin u x imucan imezwura ɣar imensiwen.
Nitni ttᵉtten tudrin n tijjař am ttᵉttaren tiwhibin di ṭṭweɛ n tẓaǧatin nsen tizirarin. Aqa ina ad ksin ijj n řḥukm iqseḥ.”
